You can talk to Claude the way you'd brief a chief of staff: several things at once, in any order. It routes requests to new or existing threads and checks in when it needs you.

The Overview panel shows what's waiting on you, and you can steer any thread, even from your phone.

Projects now run from one conversation, starting in Claude Code. You describe what needs doing, and Claude directs parallel threads that keep working after you close your laptop.

In beta today for select Pro and Max users in cloud sessions; coming to all Claude users soon.

You can also now make decks, docs, and designs in your conversation.

Draft the one-pager in Claude Docs, turn it into a deck with Claude Slides, and mock up a matching visual in Claude Design, all from one place.

Claude Cowork and chat are merging into one Claude.

Ask a quick question or hand over a report, and Claude takes it from there, even after you close your laptop. If something's unclear, Claude asks—you keep the final say.

Rolling out to Pro and Max over the next few weeks.
